svg.text: Dell Deskside Agentic AI - Technical Architecture
Common Architecture Across All Deskside Agentic AI Hardware Platforms & Operating Systems
Application Layer - Solution Templates (built on the common base)
OS Layer - DGX OS / Ubuntu / Windows (distinct OSes, shared package set; functionally common, implemented differently)
DGX OS (Ubuntu-based - Dell Pro Precision with GB10)
Ubuntu (24.04+ - Dell Pro Precision with GB300 / Precision Towers)
Hardware Layer - Dell deskside NVIDIA platforms (common silicon classes, implemented per platform)
Hardware: Dell Pro Precision with GB10 • Dell Pro Precision 9 T2 / T4 / T6 (RTX Pro 6000) • Dell Pro Precision with GB300 | OS: DGX OS (GB10) • Ubuntu • Windows
Architecture is functionally common across all platforms and operating systems - differences are implementation details, not structural.
